<observations>
Date: Jul 24, 2026
* 🔴 User prefers black coffee pre-run; works a desk job with a standing workstation; allergic to artificial strawberry flavoring.
* 🔴 User purchased Nike Vaporfly 3 running shoes; previous shoes logged at 512 km.
* 🟡 Garmin stats: 28 activities, 14.2 km max run, resting HR 54, VO2 max 47, weekly mileage 31 km. Physio set a 40 km weekly mileage cap pending knee check-up.
* 🟡 Agent calculated half marathon tapering schedule and researched maple-based endurance fuels.

Date: Jul 27, 2026
* 🔴 User prefers true crime podcasts, eating oatmeal with almond butter pre-run, and visiting farmers markets.
* 🟡 Agent provided advice on dynamic warm-ups, humidity pacing, technical fabric care, and injury management.

Date: Jul 30, 2026
* 🔴 User purchased "HydratePro" electrolyte powder; prefers shaded running routes; needs seamless socks.
* 🟡 Agent reviewed electrolyte ingredients, sweat loss formulas, and core/hip mobility routines.

Date: Aug 2, 2026
* 🔴 User registered for the Oakridge Community Half Marathon (September); booked sports massage at Metro Physical Therapy; added chia seeds to oatmeal.
* 🟡 Agent tracked Garmin Forerunner 965 (firmware 21.19), high humidity metrics (84%), and anti-friction glide strategies.

Date: Aug 6, 2026
* 🔴 User purchased a Peak Athletic Gear handheld flask and a ceramic foam roller; completed scheduled sports massage.
* 🟡 Agent calculated hourly hydration needs (500 ml/hr), asphalt impact safety, and gear maintenance.

Date: Aug 10, 2026
* 🔴 User registered for the Skyline Half Marathon (early September); ordered SoleCare replacement insoles; cleared work schedule for knee evaluation; max heart rate unknown.
* 🟡 Agent advised on pre-run fueling (banana + almonds), cadence spikes, fabric softener effects, and taper rest days.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Monitoring training load, tapering, and nutrition leading up to the September half marathon while respecting the physio's 40 km weekly mileage cap and upcoming knee evaluation.
</current-task>
